node.title: F2 admissible generating-row branch classification
node.statement: Every official maximal rate-half generating row q=p^e, ord_(2^41)(p)=e, belongs to exactly one of five residue-signed types. On p=1 mod 4 they are (v2(p-1),e)=(>=41,1),(40,2),(39,4). On p=3 mod 4 they are (v2(p+1),e)=(>=40,2),(39,4). All five types are nonempty: p=3*2^41+1, 27*2^40+1, 5*2^39+1, 2^61-1, and 25*2^39-1 respectively give certified prime witnesses with q=p^e<2^256. Thus the unsigned three-class census omits two official minus-branch classes.
